blocked_analysis.analysis: The authorization-change purpose is identifiable. Account scope, policy bits, enforcement, recovery and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines a reversible security-policy transaction and prevents guessed bitfields, production-account changes, silent privilege escalation and reliance on readback without enforcement.
independent_technical_reasoning: Payload permission is security state whose reported bits and effective behavior can diverge. A valid test must compare every field against the requested delta, exercise one bounded permitted or denied action as approved, and restore using an independent administrator path so the test is not trapped by its own authorization change.
